preregistration.expectation: No retained repository receipt for a langgraph worker/runtime acceptance check was found under evidence/artifacts/ at run time (only source_review evidence-packet claims referencing langgraph as a shortlisted dependency in sdk-runtime-coverage-20260922, plus prospective, not-executed commands in catalogs/us-equities/agents-operations.json:253-254 and catalogs/us-equities/architecture/foundation.json:850). Since this repository's own catalog specifically flags a persistent checkpointer and InMemorySaver import as the relevant acceptance surface, and the fix round's review found the prior 2-node/no-checkpointer smoke test too narrow, this re-run extends the smoke test to add an InMemorySaver-backed graph that pauses on interrupt() and resumes via Command(resume=...) on the same thread_id, then checks get_state()/get_state_history() reflect the persisted, resumed state. Both 1.2.11 and 1.2.12 are expected to produce the same final total/steps/history length; interrupt object repr may differ if the release adds fields.
preregistration.criteria: Both venvs install cleanly (`uv pip show` reports 1.2.11 / 1.2.12 respectively); smoke_test.py exits 0 in both venvs; the base 2-node StateGraph invoke/stream results are identical; the checkpointed graph pauses on interrupt(), get_state().next reports the paused node before resume, Command(resume=5) produces total=5/steps=[5] in both venvs, get_state() after resume matches, and get_state_history() reports >=2 checkpoints in both venvs. Any difference in the raw Interrupt repr (e.g. added fields) is reported, not silently normalized away.
